run.Description: Trial within the session in game order: run = (round - 1) * 4 + trial of the round, four trials per game round (run-01 ... run-12).

movement_time.Description: Duration of the movement window (first to last sample of the iPad end-effector trajectory).

vicon_valid.Description: VICON data aligned and usable: review passed (fingertip marker missing <= 10 %), the recording covers the whole movement window, the game-to-VICON offset is backed by >= 2 agreeing estimates and within 0.1 s of the consensus of its recording, and the VICON fingertip reproduces the iPad trajectory (game-trajectory test).

Levels.false: fails at least one check (see the reason column)

vicon_invalid_reason.Description: Semicolon-separated reasons why vicon_valid is false; n/a when valid.

vicon_align_source.Description: Source of the game-to-VICON clock offset of the trial.

Levels.manual: the manually marked movement start: agreeing with the recording's consensus, or taken as-is for participants aligned from manual marks only (see vicon_align_err)
Levels.xcorr: fingertip / trajectory speed cross-correlation, agreeing with the consensus
Levels.trial_consensus: the consensus offset of the recording (own estimates missing or disagreeing)
Levels.manual_trial_median: the median manual offset of the recording (participants aligned from manual marks only; this trial has no mark)
Levels.no_vicon_trial: no VICON recording of this game round

vicon_align_support.Description: Number of offset estimates of the recording (manual marks and, unless aligned from manual marks only, cross-correlations of its four trials) that agree with the consensus; <= 1 = unverified.

vicon_align_err.Description: Absolute difference between the trial's game-to-VICON offset and the consensus offset of its recording (the median of its manual offsets for participants aligned from manual marks only).

vicon_coverage.Description: Share of the movement window covered by the VICON recording (0-1).

trajectory_qa_failed.Description: Session-level game-trajectory QA (separate from the per-trial game-trajectory test of vicon_valid): the VICON fingertip, mapped to the screen leave-one-trial-out, is compared with the iPad trajectory on the session's trials that are vicon_valid and top_valid, and the session fails when the median RMSE over them exceeds 20 mm. Failed sessions are excluded from every experiment. n/a = not tested: no trial of the session is both vicon_valid and top_valid (its VICON-valid trials with a valid side view are still used).

top_valid.Description: Video of the top camera aligned and usable. The clip is present, the video match is unambiguous, the video covers the whole movement window, the trial's alignment error is < 0.1 s, the fitted clock drift is plausible (|slope - 1| <= 0.002) and the clip duration matches the movement window within 2 frames.

Levels.false: fails at least one check (see the reason column)

top_invalid_reason.Description: Semicolon-separated reasons why top_valid is false; n/a when valid. 'no clip': no video of the trial.

top_align_err.Description: Absolute residual of the trial's video-to-game offset from the offset line fitted to the video.

top_n_frames.Description: Frames of the top camera clip (movement window).

top_fps.Description: Nominal frame rate of the top camera source video: frame k of the clip is at run time k / fps. The MP4 header may round it (29.9968 -> 30).

top_video.Description: Clip of the top camera, unblurred (recorded from behind and above the participant), relative to the dataset root (sourcedata/videos/); n/a when there is no clip.

top_lead_black_frames.Description: Leading black frames of the top camera clip: the source video started after the movement start, so frames 0 to this number minus 1 have no image (labels2d and keypoints2d have no rows for them); 0 for most clips; n/a without a clip.

side_valid.Description: Video of the side camera aligned and usable. The clip is present, the video match is unambiguous, the video covers the whole movement window, the trial's alignment error is < 0.1 s, the fitted clock drift is plausible (|slope - 1| <= 0.002) and the clip duration matches the movement window within 2 frames.

Levels.false: fails at least one check (see the reason column)

side_invalid_reason.Description: Semicolon-separated reasons why side_valid is false; n/a when valid. 'no clip': no video of the trial.

side_align_err.Description: Absolute residual of the trial's video-to-game offset from the offset line fitted to the video.

side_n_frames.Description: Frames of the side camera clip (movement window).

side_fps.Description: Nominal frame rate of the side camera source video: frame k of the clip is at run time k / fps. The MP4 header may round it (29.9968 -> 30).

side_video.Description: Clip of the side camera, with the heads of all persons and the laptop screens blurred, relative to the dataset root (sourcedata/videos/); n/a when there is no clip.

side_lead_black_frames.Description: Leading black frames of the side camera clip: the source video started after the movement start, so frames 0 to this number minus 1 have no image (labels2d and keypoints2d have no rows for them); 0 for most clips; n/a without a clip.

benchmark_valid.Description: vicon_valid and at least one valid view (top or side). The paper's selection per view is vicon_valid & <view>_valid with <view>_labels present.

Levels.false: vicon_valid is false or neither view is valid

valid_views.Description: Semicolon-separated valid views (top, side); n/a when none.

vicon_motion.Description: VICON motion.tsv of the run, relative to the dataset root; n/a when the trial has no VICON data.

ipad_motion.Description: iPad end-effector motion.tsv of the run, relative to the dataset root.

events.Description: events.tsv of the run, relative to the dataset root.

top_labels.Description: 2-D labels (labels2d) of the top clip, relative to the dataset root; n/a unless the clip exists, its video is calibrated (cameras/) and the trial has VICON data.

side_labels.Description: 2-D labels (labels2d) of the side clip, relative to the dataset root; n/a unless the clip exists, its video is calibrated (cameras/) and the trial has VICON data.
